name: Echte Reizigersvrouwen
overview:
The new series is called "Real Travelers' Wives" and shows trailer park life through the eyes of women. They are often the lifeblood of the household, family, and extended family.

The women are expected to adhere to the norms, values, and traditions of the trailer park, but some are cautiously trying to move in a more modern direction. This isn't always appreciated and causes friction.
